title: Why Sanitary Tees Fail on Horizontal Drainage
description: Using a standard sanitary tee in horizontal drainage lines is a frequent mistake that leads to recurring blockages. A sanitary tee has a short sweep designed primarily for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow. When installed horizontally, waste solids slow down drastically at the junction, accumulating debris over time. For horizontal-to-horizontal branch connections, codes require a long-turn combination wye and 1/8 bend or a directional wye. This maintains fluid velocity and directs flow smoothly downstream without creating turbulence or waste buildup.
